title: HADVQ: Hessian Aware Directional Vector Quantization
abstract: arXiv:2611.22721v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Ultra-low-bit quantization of large language models is a challenging task because aggressive compression severely distorts model parameters and disproportionately harms a small number of highly sensitive channels. We present a vector quantization method tailored for this regime. Our approach begins with random preconditioning, which regularizes the weight space and makes it more amenable to quantization. We then represent weights in polar coordinates and decouple the quantization of directions and magnitudes. To quantize directions, we leverage the structure induced by random preconditioning and design a structured codebook based on the $E_8$ lattice, yielding a compact yet expressive representation. To further reduce degradation, we detect extremely important channels using a proxy Hessian and preserve them with an additional cost of only 0.16 bits. translated_title: HADVQ：基于Hessian感知的方向向量量化
translated_abstract: 超低比特的大语言模型量化是一项具有挑战性的任务，因为激进的压缩会严重扭曲模型参数，并对少数高度敏感的通道造成不成比例的损害。我们提出了一种专为这一场景量身定制的向量量化方法。我们的方法首先采用随机预条件化，对权重空间进行正则化，使其更易于量化。然后我们将权重表示为极坐标形式，并将方向与幅度的量化解耦。为了量化方向，我们利用随机预条件化所诱导的结构，设计了基于 $E_8$ 格的结构化码本，从而获得紧凑而富有表现力的表示。为了进一步减少性能退化，我们使用代理Hessian检测极其重要的通道，并以仅0.16比特的额外成本将其保留。这些组件共同为超低比特场景下的大语言模型提供了一个有效的量化流水线。
tldr: 提出了一种面向超低比特LLM量化的向量量化方法HADVQ，通过随机预条件化正则化权重空间、在极坐标下使用基于E8格的结构化码本解耦方向与幅度的量化，并利用代理Hessian以仅0.16比特的额外开销保护高度敏感通道。
en_tdlr: HADVQ is a vector quantization method for ultra-low-bit LLM quantization that combines random preconditioning, an E8 lattice-based structured codebook for decoupled polar-coordinate directional quantization, and proxy-Hessian-based preservation of highly sensitive channels at only 0.16 bits of extra cost.
